title: Niuhuang Jiedu Tablet's compatibility alleviates realgar-induced intestinal toxicity by activating aryl hydrocarbon receptor pathway via Akkermansia and indole-3-lactate.
authors: Li, Jianchao; Ma, Yuanjing; Deng, Nuo; Wang, Fei; Tao, Yi; Zhu, Huilin; Xu, Weichen; Shan, Jinjun; Li, Yongming; Wu, Xiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过肠道菌群和代谢物激活AhR通路减轻雄黄肠毒性，核心为药理毒理机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Realgar is a traditional Chinese medicine rich in arsenic, and long-term use may lead to arsenic poisoning. The toxicity of realgar has primarily focused on the liver and kidney, with limited studies on its intestinal toxicity. Niuhuang Jiedu Tablet (NHJDT) is a renowned realgar-containing formula for clearing heat and detoxifying. NHJDT compatibility significantly reduces the toxicity of realgar, but the detoxification effects and underlying mechanisms in reducing realgar-induced intestinal toxicity remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: The study aims to investigate the detoxification mechanism of NHJDT's compatibility in reducing the intestinal toxicity of realgar. MATERIALS AND METHODS: To evaluate the intestinal detoxification efficacy of NHJDT, mice were orally administered 0.5 % CMC-Na, realgar (0.5 and 1.0 g/kg) or NHJDT (3.9 and 7.8 g/kg) for 14 days. The intestinal detoxification effects of NHJDT were evaluated by toxic symptoms and intestinal barrier function. Changes of body weight, colon length, histopathological damage, tight junction and MUC2 proteins, and goblet cells were determined. The inflammatory factors and DAO were detected by ELISA. Further investigations including 16S rRNA sequencing, untargeted metabolomics, targeted short-chain fatty acid metabolomics and molecular docking assays were performed to explore the underlying detoxification mechanisms of NHJDT. Additionally, targeted microbiota and its derived metabolite gavage were conducted in mice to verify the detoxification effects. RESULTS: NHJDT's compatibility significantly mitigated realgar-induced intestinal toxicity and gut barrier damage. It restored gut microbiota homeostasis by modulating the abundance of Akkermansia and concurrently enhanced the transformation from tryptophan to indole-3- lactate (ILA). The supplementation with Akkermansia muciniphila (A. muciniphila) and its derived ILA activated the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) in mice, thereby ameliorating realgar-induced intestinal damage. CONCLUSION: NHJDT's compatibility alleviated realgar-induced intestinal toxicity by activating the AhR pathway via A. muciniphila and ILA. This study elucidates the detoxification mechanism of NHJDT's compatibility and offers novel insights for the clinical treatment of arsenic poisoning.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：雄黄是一种富含砷的传统中药，长期使用可能导致砷中毒。雄黄的毒性研究主要集中在肝脏和肾脏，对其肠道毒性的研究有限。牛黄解毒片（NHJDT）是一种著名的含雄黄方剂，用于清热解毒。NHJDT配伍显著降低雄黄的毒性，但其在减少雄黄诱导的肠道毒性方面的解毒效果及潜在机制尚不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨NHJDT配伍降低雄黄肠道毒性的解毒机制。材料与方法：为评估NHJDT的肠道解毒效果，小鼠口服给予0.5% CMC-Na、雄黄（0.5和1.0 g/kg）或NHJDT（3.9和7.8 g/kg）14天。通过中毒症状和肠道屏障功能评估NHJDT的肠道解毒效果。测定体重变化、结肠长度、组织病理损伤、紧密连接和MUC2蛋白以及杯状细胞。通过ELISA检测炎症因子和DAO。进一步研究包括16S rRNA测序、非靶向代谢组学、靶向短链脂肪酸代谢组学和分子对接实验，以探索NHJDT的潜在解毒机制。此外，在小鼠中进行靶向微生物及其衍生代谢物的灌胃，以验证解毒效果。结果：NHJDT配伍显著减轻了雄黄诱导的肠道毒性和肠道屏障损伤。它通过调节阿克曼菌（Akkermansia）的丰度恢复肠道微生物稳态，并同时增强色氨酸向吲哚-3-乳酸（ILA）的转化。补充阿克曼菌（A. muciniphila）及其衍生的ILA激活了小鼠体内的芳烃受体（AhR），从而改善雄黄诱导的肠道损伤。结论：NHJDT配伍通过A. muciniphila和ILA激活AhR通路，减轻了雄黄诱导的肠道毒性。本研究阐明了NHJDT配伍的解毒机制，并为砷中毒的临床治疗提供了新见解。
